title: Surreal Eye of the Mind
description: A large glowing mechanical eye dominates a dark cosmic night sky, its iris containing a silhouetted figure holding a sign that reads 'NO MORE HEROES'. In the foreground, two grey aliens stand near a stone bridge entwined with a purple dragon, while a mummy-like figure holds a 'NO MIND' sign. A human hand with pink nails reaches upward from vibrant alien flora, with reflective puddles on the path below.
prompt: Surreal night scene featuring a massive mechanical eye floating in a starry sky with galaxies and orange clouds. Inside the eye's pupil is a black silhouette holding an orange sign saying 'NO MORE HEROES'. Two grey aliens with large heads stand on the left, one reaching toward the eye. A purple dragon coils around a stone bridge and staircase. A bandaged figure holds a sign reading 'NO MIND'. A human hand with long pink nails emerges from the bottom foreground among glowing alien plants and reflective puddles on a cobblestone path. Street lamps, music notes, and a dark whimsical atmosphere.
